name: prd-pr
description: Claude Code variant of the workshop dev workflow — orchestrator skill plus helper subagents (code-explorer, code-architect, plan-reviewer, impl-backend, impl-frontend, impl-simplify, code-reviewer, test-plan-walker) and the supporting skill suite, including a consolidated post-implementation quality round (independent code review, refactor, smoke, test-suite regression over the whole story), a resumable 07-progress.md ledger, and an end-to-end test-plan walkthrough that runs in a clean subagent context, embeds agent-browser screenshots into the PR description, and persists a Playwright e2e spec per slice into the project's existing e2e suite.
